entities.name: Maja Savić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maja Savić is a Serbian volleyball player, playing as a middle-blocker. She is part of the Serbia women's national volleyball team. She won the bronze medal at the 2015 European Games in Baku. At club level she played for Vizura Belgrade in 2015. Since 2021 she is a part of the SC Potsdam 1. national league volleyball team.
